messages.author: 28f7cf43544f2467
messages.subject: scale_colour_manual issues
parts:
I am noticing an issue with scale_colour_brewer and
scale_colour_manual and would like to solicit input on whether this is
a bug or I am not doing something correctly.

I am producing a plot with the following code:

p =
ggplot(plates3,aes(ce_coupling_efficiency,proportion,colour=category))
p + geom_step() +
scale_colour_manual(values=alpha(c("gold1","dodgerblue2"),0.6))

example image (http://dl.dropbox.com/u/3734701/
scale_colour_manual.jpg)

This results in a plot with empty legend boxes. The boxes have no
lines indicating the factor level.

If I produce the same plot...but specify the colours of the lines with
scale_colour_brewer...the plot legend is displayed as I would
expect...colored lines indicating the factors.

p =
ggplot(plates3,aes(ce_coupling_efficiency,proportion,colour=category))
p + geom_step() + scale_colour_brewer(palette="Set1")

example image (http://dl.dropbox.com/u/3734701/
scale_colour_brewer.jpg)

I'd like to understand why this doesn't work as I would like the
flexibility to specify colors for these types of plots. Thanks in
advance for any ideas.

Hi Nick,

For bitmap devices it works if the resolution is increased.

library(ggplot2)
df <- data.frame(x = c(1, 2), y = c(1, 2), f = c("a", "a"))
png("deleteme.png", width = 7, height = 7, unit = "in", res = 600)

qplot(x = x, y = y, colour = f, data = df) +
geom_line() +
scale_colour_manual(values = alpha("red", 0.6))
dev.off()

Hope this helps,
fernando
